segments.sn25.2:1.8: Yo, bhikkhave, ime dhamme evaṃ saddahati adhimuccati, ayaṃ vuccati saddhānusārī, okkanto sammattaniyāmaṃ, sappurisabhūmiṃ okkanto, vītivatto puthujjanabhūmiṃ;
segments.sn25.2:1.9: abhabbo taṃ kammaṃ kātuṃ, yaṃ kammaṃ katvā nirayaṃ vā tiracchānayoniṃ vā pettivisayaṃ vā upapajjeyya;
segments.sn25.2:1.10: abhabbo ca tāva kālaṃ kātuṃ yāva na sotāpattiphalaṃ sacchikaroti”.
segments.sn25.2:2.1: “Yassa kho, bhikkhave, ime dhammā evaṃ paññāya mattaso nijjhānaṃ khamanti, ayaṃ vuccati – ‘dhammānusārī, okkanto sammattaniyāmaṃ, sappurisabhūmiṃ okkanto, vītivatto puthujjanabhūmiṃ;
segments.sn25.2:2.2: abhabbo taṃ kammaṃ kātuṃ, yaṃ kammaṃ katvā nirayaṃ vā tiracchānayoniṃ vā pettivisayaṃ vā upapajjeyya;
segments.sn25.2:2.3: abhabbo ca tāva kālaṃ kātuṃ yāva na sotāpattiphalaṃ sacchikaroti’.
segments.sn25.2:2.4: Yo, bhikkhave, ime dhamme evaṃ pajānāti evaṃ passati, ayaṃ vuccati –

lines: Abhabbo ca tāva kālaṃ kātunti iminā uppanne magge phalassa anantarāyataṃ dīpeti.
Uppannasmiñhi magge phalassa antarāyakaraṇaṃ nāma natthi.

“ayañca puggalo sotāpattiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno assa, kappassa ca uḍḍayhanavelā assa, neva tāva kappo uḍḍayheyya, yāvāyaṃ puggalo na sotāpattiphalaṃ sacchikaroti, ayaṃ vuccati puggalo ṭhitakappī”ti (pu. pa. 17).
Saddhādhimokkhanti saddahanavasena pavattaṃ adhimokkhaṃ, na sanniṭṭhānamattavasena pavattaṃ adhimokkhaṃ.
So hi uḍḍayhati, na kappo, uḍḍayhanavelāti jhāyanavelā.
Ṭhito kappo ṭhitakappo, so assa atthīti ṭhitakappī, kappaṃ ṭhapetuṃ samatthoti attho.
